A signed [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]] card, inscribed "Cheers, Juz" and "Decipher's Jedi Knight". Signed by [[Justin Pakes]], as identified in replies to the source post, including one by jbhelfrich: "The first one is definitely Justin/Juz Pakes".

Source: photo posted by _Sols_Golden_Curse_ in [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1n61y5w/does_anyone_recognize_these_signatures/ "Does anyone recognize these signatures?"], r/starwarsccg, Reddit (1 September 2025); original image https://i.redd.it/ydtgeilakmmf1.jpeg (4032 by 3024 pixels). Preserved copy of the post: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185849/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-1n61y5w.html Internet Archive]. The image URL https://i.redd.it/ydtgeilakmmf1.jpeg could not be archived (Save Page Now returned errors). The photo shows three signed cards; this file is the Obi-Wan With Lightsaber card cropped from box (130,560)–(1365,2320) and reduced to 600 by 855 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: f34bf066cd7a21055547683ea60bf38338a414726804b623c76240d9b7abd2bf.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single cropped, reduced-size photo of one signed card from a fan's Reddit post, used only to show the signature on the signer's page on a non-commercial fan wiki. The card art is © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It cannot replace the card or the photo, and no freely licensed image of this signed card is known.
